scenario: Multi-justifier per LLOG.2.4 — a logical fact is retracted only when the last justification goes away. Two rules each justify Occupied. Retract the first justifier: Occupied stays (second rule still active). Retract the second: Occupied retracts. Observable: exactly one fact_retract for Occupied at the end, not after the first retract. Event kinds do not name the fact, so the `pump` boundaries are stated: a retract's justification change happens at the retract, before the next pump. So one fact_retract (t1's) before the second pump, and two (t2's, then Occupied's) before the third. Three fact_retracts with no boundary hold as well when Occupied goes with t1, which is why the boundaries are stated.
rules_ds:
schema Trig1 scope logical:
    v: Int key

schema Trig2 scope logical:
    v: Int key

schema Occupied scope logical:
    dummy: Int key

rule r1:
    Trig1
->
    emit Occupied logical dummy: 0

rule r2:
    Trig2
->
    emit Occupied logical dummy: 0
